name: Jet
description: A single-seat jet fighter on tricycle gear: one engine pushes from a nozzle behind its tail with more thrust than the jet weighs, so it climbs steeply, and it flies level on its own near cruising speed.
comment: A vehicle preset (#379): see sedan.json for the format and plane.json for the aircraft block. An F-16C Block 50: 10,430 kg with half its fuel and a 75 kg pilot (the preset is 10,355), a 27.9 m^2 wing of span 9.45 m (aspect ratio 3.2), one F110-GE-129 nozzle behind the tail: 76.3 kN dry (engines.thrust) and 131 kN with the afterburner (engines.afterburnerThrust, the throttle's last tenth: W held all the way), spooling from idle to full in 3.5 s (spoolTime). Its wing's peak lift 1.8 at 25 degrees puts level flight at 160 knots near the real 11-degree approach angle; the tail stalls later than the wing. The air-speed limit 250 m/s (900 km/h) is the owner's cap: the fuselage drag is set so the dry engine tops out just below it and the afterburner reaches it. Ailerons tuned to about 90 degrees a second (the owner's pick; a real F-16 rolls far faster). cruiseSpeed and cruiseThrottle are the trim schema/validate.py and FMantleChassisDerive solve.
